description: Sky noise levels read from Euclid's DR1 Wide Survey MER noise (RMS) maps: one random position per sampled interior Wide tile, the median of noise-map values below five times the window median in a 256x256 pixel (25.6 arcsec, one generated scene) window read from the cloud-hosted mosaic, in stack electrons per 0.1 arcsec pixel via each mosaic's MAGZERO. Every row also carries sub_levels_e, the 4x4 grid of 64-pixel sub-tile levels. Not read by the generator.
